name: FFS_RESOURCE_WORK_ZONE
description: Contains work zones configured on the resource level.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the resource work zone record.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the resource this work zone is assigned to.

columns.name: WORK_ZONE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to WORK_ZONE_ID in FFS_WORK_ZONE.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Work zone activation start date. Example: 2019-02-25.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Work zone activation end date. Example: 2019-02-25, only for temporary Work Zones.

columns.name: RECURRENCE
columns.description: Indicates schedule for the Work Zone if the resource is alternating between Work Zone assignments. Example: 'daily', 'weekly, 'none'.

columns.name: RECUR_EVERY
columns.description: Indicates number of days after which the assignment of the Work Zone repeats. Value is 0 in case the 'recurrence' field is set to 'none'.

columns.name: WEEKDAYS
columns.description: Indicates weekdays in case 'reccurence' is set to 'weekly'. Value is defined as power of 2 for each week day. Example Sunday is 1 (2 pow 0), Wednesday is 8, Saturday is 64. Selected week days values are summed up. Example selected Mon, Wed, Fri value will be 42.

columns.name: RATIO
columns.description: Indicates ratio of assigned work zone to a resource in range of 1 to 100. Means level of the likelihood that this resource is assigned activities in this work zone.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Indicates type of Work Zone, value can be 'regular' in case the assigned Work Zone is new to the resource or 'override' in case the Work Zone is already assigned to the parent bucket.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
